# Studio skill: art identity and targeted refinement

Status: `PROPOSED`. Roles: `game-artist`. Department: game. Source commit `6f7d18dfc3c3c6b471438288c99f448d1bada42c`.

## Purpose

Keep an entity recognisably itself when you refine an approved asset or redraw it in a new pose, view or state, and choose seeds by evidence instead of habit. It adds no rule and grants no permission: every mandatory rule is in your role instructions, and the permission layer decides what you may run.

## When to use it

- the Task asks for a targeted refinement of an approved asset (one listed defect, one region);
- the Task asks for a new action pose, alternate view, transformation state, new bind pose, or rig-ready / animation-driven art of an existing entity;
- you are about to choose or reuse a seed for a variant of an existing asset.

## Operating procedure

1. Open `reference/seed-and-identity.md` (this skill's supporting file) and the Task's brief; write the three lists: identity invariants, pose-specific properties, replaceable representations. Ask in your Task comment when the brief does not give them.
2. Targeted refinement: change only the listed issue. Make a mask with `python -I ~/game-studio-workspace/tools/art-ops.py mask <mask.png> --like <source.png> --rect X Y W H [--feather N]` (the output path comes first and has no flag; give exactly one of `--like <image>` or `--size W H`; `--rect` is x, y, width, height and may repeat; `--ellipse` and `--polygon` also work) and repaint that region with `python -I ~/game-studio-workspace/tools/comfy-edit.py inpaint` (SDXL), or use `python -I ~/game-studio-workspace/tools/comfy-edit.py img2img` at low denoise for family consistency.
3. New pose, view or state: judge the result against the identity invariants, not against the source pixels or silhouette, and list which pose-specific properties changed.
4. Seeds: treat a reused seed as one candidate to test; record every seed, its result and why you kept or rejected it.
5. Compare before and after at target size with `python -I ~/game-studio-workspace/tools/art-ops.py contact` and check unintended changes with `python -I ~/game-studio-workspace/tools/art-ops.py diff`; revert a fix that breaks an invariant.
6. When no allowed command can carry the invariants into the new pose, post the blocker lines (`Type: permission` or `decision`) as your role instructions say; never work around a refusal.

## Approved dependencies

- `comfyui`: integrated; used only through comfy-draft.py and comfy-edit.py (dependencies/registry.yaml)
- `sd-xl-base-1-0`: integrated; the only model for inpaint
- `flux1-schnell-fp8`: integrated; img2img and drafts only (no FLUX inpainting)
- `comfyui-embedded-python`: integrated; runs art-ops.py

## Known limitations

- Status `PROPOSED`: prepared for the game-artist pilot (change C); not assigned until the Board approves that change.
- Discovery by the agent, use without being named, and reading of the supporting file are UNVERIFIED until pilot run P1.
- Inserting new objects with inpaint failed 0/10 in SOU-64; region edits are approved only on the project's own art.
- Not approved: reference images from outside the project, image-prompt adapters, LoRA, ControlNet, FLUX inpainting.
- R&D-only tools (R&D ComfyUI, FLUX.2 klein, SAM 3.1, ViTPose, ToonOut, Fooocus inpaint patch, Krita) are not available.
